title: Post-Processor + Tool Library MS1 Improvements (batched)
brief: Three MS1 ships covering the 8-gap punch list from HURCO-VM30I-SCENARIOS-MS0's capability assessment + the Fusion tool extractor improvements + a false-positive fix in the post-processor coverage audit. Closes user directive 'do them all as your goal and loop them' (2026-05-24, slot echo).

close_out_log.note: mcp-server/src/__tests__/HurcoV11GapFillMS1.test.ts (9/9 PASS) — closes 3 highest-value gaps from MS0 capability assessment: (Gap #4) tribal_tips_applied[] non-zero on face/pocket/tap ops — engine's 20+ JM Die tribal tips are now verified to fire; (Gap #5) estimated_cycle_min in plausible range, monotone-decreasing in feed rate, additive across 3-op chain — feeds JM Die quote estimator; (Gap #3) drill/tap/bore canned-cycle structural assertions — T+M06+S+M03+Z-depth+M30 all verified per op type. Same engine, no API change.

scripts/extract-jm-milling-tools-fusion.mjs MS1 enhancement: (a) pickHolder() — type-aware holder selection (BT40 face-mill holder / BT40 endmill / ER32 / ER20 micro); (b) pickStartValues() — per-ISO group preset table (aluminum 6061 @ 500 SFM, steel 4140 @ 350 SFM, stainless 304 @ 200 SFM) with chipload scaled by tool diameter (mm/tooth); (c) unknown-vendor quarantine — 3376 tools without manufacturer attribution split into state/shared/jm-fusion-tools/unknown-vendor-tools.json so they don't pollute the main Fusion library. Final attributed library: 15994 milling tools (down from 19370 — quarantined the unprovenance set).

scripts/audit-post-processor-coverage.mjs — broadened listEngineFiles() filter to catch *PostEngine.ts (canonical PRISM naming), not only *PostProcessorEngine + *PostGeneratorEngine. R12 fail-loud win: PPSinkerEDMPostEngine (Mitsubishi EA12V — the actual JM Die sinker EDM) was MS0-invisible because its filename matched neither prior pattern. Re-run: coverage 64/84→66/84 (Mitsubishi wedm-sinker + Okuma wedm-sinker flipped ❌→✓1). Audit-side correction, not engine work — closes false-positive class in MS0 envelope's R1 (heuristic loose).

units.description: MS0 R1 closed: my own audit was silently miscategorizing the universe of engines because the file filter regex was too narrow. Same R12 fail-loud class as iter1 PSN-Synergy collector blind-spot — eat your own dog food, fix the gap your audit surfaces.

acceptance: 9/9 + Fusion extractor 15994 attributed + coverage matrix 66/84 with wedm-sinker no longer universal-gap. The 4th user-named deliverable (operator-side validation) is operator-action — drag proveout-latest.hnc into WinMax + jm-milling-tools.tools into Fusion.

risks.description: POST-PROCESSOR-COVERAGE-MS1 doesn't fix the heuristic loose-coupling — brand+machineClass co-occurrence still counts. MS2 would need explicit @brand / @machine JSDoc annotation parsing for hard accuracy.

5 of the 8 named MS0 gaps remain open: G65 conversational mode, tool_change_position, advanced_aggressiveness arithmetic, add_optional_stops M01, MillTool stickout deflection. MS2 picks these up as a focused 5-test batch.

Fusion start-values presets use textbook SFM × chipload (not JM Die calibrated values). Operator may need to dial them in for the specific machine/material/tool combo. Mitigation: presets are starting points the Fusion dialog populates — operator tunes from there, same as a hand-keyed entry.
